item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera connects a cell, a lamp and a switch in series to check her science project at home, as shown in the figure.

When the switch is in the position shown, what happens to the lamp?

options.A: The lamp glows, because the switch itself supplies current to the lamp.
options.B: The lamp glows, because the switch has closed the gap and completed the circuit.
options.C: The lamp stays off, because the open switch has broken the path of the circuit.
options.D: The lamp stays off, because a cell can never light a lamp without a switch.
